verdict.rationale: Railway documents instant rollback of deployments, per-PR previews, and agent-opened pull requests for code fixes. None of these is a documented capability to version, review, and roll back automations such as workflows, scheduled jobs, or agent-driven automation rules. Deployment rollback and code PRs are adjacent features, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
